interpretation_limits: Nuclear-channel SSIM after translation is a registration-quality proxy, not ground-truth deformation.
DAB strata are color-based groups, not clinical HER2 0/1+/2+/3+ labels.
The secondary clean subset must not replace the full-test headline result.
Per-stratum SSIM/MAE/PSNR are computed at 256x256 for analysis and are not the headline full-resolution metrics.
